Subject: Renewal + private offer for Redwood Inference (ACME-7832)

Hi Rafael,

We're preparing to renew our Redwood contract that hits term on 2026-06-30. We want to: 1) renew the reserved capacity commitment for another 12 months, and 2) increase committed gpu-hours by ~35% to support a new model rollout in Q3.

Because we're procuring via AWS Marketplace, we need a Private Offer/PO package that reflects the new term and increased commitment. Can you send the paperwork and confirm:
- the SKU(s) for the added capacity and how they'll appear on the PO
- whether a mid-term proration will apply for the capacity add-on (we expect the upsell to start 2026-07-15)
- any changes to billing cadence (monthly vs. upfront) if we move to a 12 -> 18 month term

Our procurement contact is Daniel Park (cc'd). Our legal entity and billing details are attached in the template you'll ask for. We need to have the Marketplace private offer submitted and accepted by AWS by 2026-06-24 to avoid service interruption.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Analytics

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear ask and heads up on timeline. We're ready to support this and here's how we'll proceed: 

1) I'll attach a short amendment (Redwood_AMENDMENT_v1.docx) that outlines the term extension, new committed gpu-hours, and the price tiers for overage. Please confirm committed quantity (GPU hours / token estimate) — I put a placeholder for a 35% uplift.
2) For AWS Marketplace Private Offers: we'll create the Private Offer from our vendor console and send a buyer-accept link to Acme's marketplace account. AWS typically needs the buyer's legal entity name, billing address, and a PO number.
3) Proration: we generally prorate the new committed capacity from the effective date of the amendment to the next invoice period. If you want the upgrade to start 2026-07-15 we can prorate for Jul 15 - Aug 1 (example).
4) Term options: we can offer 12, 18, or 24 month commitment lengths. Moving to 18 months would allow a modest discount (we've penciled ~7% on the incremental capacity). If you'd like me to price 12 v 18 v 24, tell me which you prefer and I will run the numbers.

Next steps I need from Acme: completed AWS_Private_Offer_Form.xlsx with legal entity & billing contact + your preferred term (12/18/24) and effective date for the capacity increase. Once we have that, Vanessa (cc'd) will lead the Marketplace submission and Laura will coordinate PO processing for our billing team.

I'll also put the amendment in DocuSign and create a draft private offer. ETA to send the private offer to you: 2-3 business days after we receive the completed form.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Daniel — got everything, and thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick summary of actions we've taken and next steps: 

- I have created the amendment and put it in DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/transaction/abcd-1234 (link above). Please sign there (recommended) so we can attach the signed amendment to the AWS Private Offer.
